---
name: claim-policy
description: Checks an expense claim against the travel, meals and equipment policy before it is submitted, and says which rule a rejected claim broke.
---

# Claim policy

1. Identify the expense category from the claim: travel, meals or equipment.
2. A meals claim above 60 dollars a day is returned with the limit quoted.
3. An equipment claim above 400 dollars needs a manager's approval first.
4. Entertainment and gifts are never claimable; return the claim and say so.
5. A claim within policy goes on to submit_claim.
